verdict.rationale: AFK lets users set a natural-language goal (e.g., 'Get to $1m ARR') which the AI decomposes into a task graph/workflow of steps, effectively generating a workflow from a prompt (afk-docs-6, afk-docs-13, afk-docs-8, afk-docs-14). However, there's no evidence of editing an existing workflow via natural language, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of this behavior. Missing for 10: evidence of prompt-based editing of already-generated workflows, independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs.
